title: ScheduleRegistrationDocument
description: The Azure Cosmos DB document shape for a deployment-global schedule registration: scheduleId to the (environment, runId) address of its scheduler run.

id.description: The deployment-globally-unique schedule id (also the partition key, so the create conflict on (partition key, id) is the uniqueness gate).

environment.description: The deployment environment the schedule (and its fired runs) are pinned to.

runId.description: The scheduler run's id (the schedule's derived address, ADR 0065 decision 9).
